description: Call this when a user asks whether they need a sales tax permit, seller's permit or GST/HST/PST registration, what it's called, or which agency issues it, for a US state or Canadian province. Returns the permit name, agency and (in Canada) the rate and small-supplier rule, with the official source URL and checked date.

jurisdiction.description: A US state or Canadian province: two-letter code (TX, ON), US-TX / CA-ON, or the full name. "CA" means California; use "Canada" or a province code for Canada. "US" or "Canada" alone means federal only.

name: get_sales_tax_registration
title: Get sales tax registration details
